name: @zello-ai/widget
description: Embeddable customer widget. Vite + a Shadow-DOM web component — deliberately not Next.js, since it ships as a standalone <script> tag on partner sites, not a hosted app. Two build targets (see vite.config.ts): a text-only bundle and a voice-capable bundle, gated by tenant phase entitlement — see docs/architecture/auth-flow.md and the SRS's IP-protection requirement.
